data.narrative:
Arbe Robotics operates in the Drones & Autonomous sector at the public stage, having raised $118M to date. The comparable universe consists of seven private peers, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air. No public comps exist within the narrow Drones & Autonomous peer set, limiting direct market-based benchmarking.

The peer-median approach is not applicable to this analysis. The sector contains only five same-stage peers total, and filtering by adjacent-stage companies, similar valuation tier, or other refinements yields fewer than three datapoints—below the minimum threshold for reliable median calculation. An all-sector median would introduce substantial noise and is therefore inapplicable.

This analysis cannot proceed to a triangulated valuation range without additional data on comparable transaction multiples, revenue or EBITDA figures for peer companies, or recent funding round terms within the peer set. The absence of public comps and the sparseness of the private peer set—particularly when filtered by stage and tier—prevent application of standard multiple-based or precedent transaction methodologies. Further diligence would require either expansion to adjacent subsectors (e.g., robotics, autonomous vehicles) with documented caution on comparability, or reliance on management guidance and bottom-up operational forecasting to establish a defensible valuation floor.
